world_model_delta: Resource stockpiles decay at 5% per turn if held beyond MAX_STOCKPILE=50 per resource type per island. Decay is calculated per island per resource at turn-end. Resources transferred away before decay calculation are unaffected.
validator_question: Does resource decay create an incentive to transfer resources before decay?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — decay incentivizes transfer; expected behavior; no governance implication
